name: Disciplined Hero
body:
Prerequisites: 5th-level psion, at least 2 levels in non-psion classes.

Benefit: You add half your total levels in non-psion classes to your psion level when determining if you gain or improve your psionic discipline abilities.

If you are an 11th-level or higher psion, add half your total levels in non-psion classes to your effective manifester level when augmenting powers you already know.

Special: Any progressive bonuses gained with Disciplined Hero are limited to a maximum of your character level.
